headline: BI Pours Rp466.2 T in Liquidity Incentives for Banks Until Early November
summary: Bank Indonesia has provided Rp 466.2 trillion in macroprudential liquidity incentives through early November to encourage bank lending, according to the report.
why: Macroprudential liquidity incentives are central bank tools that encourage banks to extend credit, affecting lending growth and bank earnings.
original_headline: BI Guyur Bank Insentif Likuiditas Rp466,2 T hingga Awal November
